presets.name: Vocal Cinema (4 layers)
presets.intent: Four parallel layers: the cleaned vocal, an air layer, a ducked cathedral and a ducked ping-pong echo - each with its own EQ.

presets.name: Drum Factory (serial layers)
presets.intent: Serial layers as a production line: clean-up, colour, glue - each stage on its own layer.

presets.name: Drums Parallel Monster
presets.intent: Three layers: the bus, a destroyed parallel crush, and a Revolution glitch layer blended at 25 %.

presets.name: Split-Band Bass Layers
presets.intent: Three layers split by EQ: the bass, a saturated mono sub layer and a wide transient top layer.

presets.name: Vocal Octave Choir
presets.intent: Layers with pitched echoes an octave down and up: one vocal becomes a small choir.

presets.name: Beat Switch-Up
presets.intent: HamloRevolution MUSICAL on the drums: tape stops, repeats and half time - a different bar every time.

presets.name: Vocal Chop Machine
presets.intent: Revolution EXPERIMENTAL on a vocal: chops, reverses and width motion.

presets.name: Full Mix Destruction
presets.intent: Revolution DESTRUCTION on the whole mix at 50 % with STALIN: a breakdown in one click.

presets.name: Bass Gated Motion
presets.intent: Revolution as a rhythmic volume gate on bass / pads (no chops).

presets.name: Revolution Width Pulse
presets.intent: Revolution motion on WIDTH: the mix breathes mono-wide on the grid.

presets.name: Revolution Crush Fills
presets.intent: Revolution with CRUSH motion and glitches on drums: bitcrushed fills.

presets.name: De-Ess + Air Exciter
presets.intent: A point with modules: the 8-14 kHz band gets its own Tube exciter while the DE-ESS point holds the s.

presets.name: Kick-Only Reverb
presets.intent: A region: only 40-120 Hz goes into a big reverb - a huge kick tail without washing the mix.

presets.name: Vocal Band Saturation
presets.intent: Saturation on the voice's presence band only (1.5-5 kHz region): grit without harshness.

presets.name: Hi-Hat Only Echo
presets.intent: A region on the hats (6-16 kHz) gets a ping-pong echo; kick and snare stay dry.

presets.name: Snare Band Reverb
presets.intent: A point at 220 Hz carries a plate on its band: only the snare body blooms.

presets.name: Lenin + Stalin Full Chain
presets.intent: Both tubes: LENIN into STALIN on the whole mix (MIX 70 / 50 %).

presets.name: Stalin Vocal Radio
presets.intent: STALIN at full on a band-limited vocal: a 1950s broadcast.

presets.name: Lenin Vocal Warmth
presets.intent: BRING LENIN BACK alone on a vocal at full: tube warmth without other colour.

presets.name: Stalin Drum Room
presets.intent: STALIN plus a crushed room on drums - the transformer roar of a 1950s studio.
